title: Fabrication of copper silicate microspheres using rice husk ash and its application for dearomatization of phenol derivatives
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,49557-49564
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09185C, Paper
Open Access

Na Li, Lide Su, Hongying Wang, Hongdao Li, Qianqian Shen, Xiaofeng Han
The copper silicate microspheres were hydrothermally synthesized using high-silicon rice husk ash as the raw material, demonstrating superior catalytic performance in the dearomatization reaction.
